text:
hannah: hey team, first morning here! quick setup questions: signed into Okta but my app grid is empty, Google Drive doesn't show the shared 'infra' folder my manager sent, 1Password invite says 'token expired' when i click, and trying to add a passkey (Touch ID) says 'Registration failed: challenge mismatch'. who should I bug? :wave:
it-support: welcome hannah! can you confirm you used your @redwood.com address and not a personal alias? also which browser/os?
hannah: yep hannah.k@redwood.com. MacBook Air macOS 12.5, Chrome 114.
onboarding-bot: Hi hannah! Provisioning usually finishes within 15m. If you still see issues tag @it-support and @idp-engineer. Docs: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/quickstart :book:
idp-engineer: tagging in. quick glance: SCIM job shows 'partial success' for hannah.k due to a missing group id mapping — apps weren't applied. i'll run a manual groupsync.
it-support: also try logging into Okta in an incognito window (clears stale sessions). for 1Password we'll reissue the invite after idp confirms user record.
hannah: incognito still empty. thanks for kicking the resync.
idp-engineer: forced resync at 08:02 UTC — saw group mapping 404 caused by a recently renamed group 'eng-infra' -> 'infra-eng'. reverted the mapping and re-ran. apps should be assigned now; re-sent 1Password invite to hannah.k@redwood.com with a fresh token.
hannah: got the new 1Password link, it opened fine. Drive still says 'Request access' when i follow the manager link.
matt-manager: i re-shared the infra drive and added hannah directly. refresh?
hannah: Drive opened after refresh, thanks. passkey still failing though — same "challenge mismatch".
it-support: that usually means the browser session started the challenge but the response came from a different origin or there was a clock skew. steps: 1) fully quit Chrome, reboot, try Safari; 2) ensure system clock is correct; 3) try registering from a private window.
hannah: tried Safari private, same error. my laptop clock shows correct time.
idp-engineer: can you try registering the passkey on your personal laptop just to isolate if it's device-specific?
hannah: personal laptop worked — passkey registered there. so something on the company image is interfering.
it-support: thanks — we'll open a hardware ticket. for now we'll enable Okta Verify (push) and mark passkey enrollment optional for a day. hannah, i'll enable push on your account now.
it-support: enabled Okta Verify. hannah, can you install the app and scan the QR?
hannah: Okta Verify setup succeeded. i can access apps now. huge thanks all!
idp-engineer: root cause summary: SCIM group mapping broke after group rename; idp reverted mapping and re-ran groupsync, apps and Drive ACLs fixed, 1Password invite reissued. passkey failure isolated to company image (challenge mismatch); workaround is Okta Verify until IT reimages or issues replacement. follow-up: i'll add a guard to the group-rename pipeline and notify infra.
matt-manager: welcome aboard hannah! ping me for the infra onboarding doc. :coffee: 
it-support: closing loop — everything working except passkey on company image which will be tracked in ticket TKT-4821. DM us if anything else. :white_check_mark:
